summary: Added Makefile targets for install, format, gitleaks, build, and precommit workflows; configured Husky pre-commit hooks; added Prettier-based formatting helpers and gitleaks scripts; installed dev dependencies; verified the hook pipeline end-to-end.
timeline: Reviewed the existing Makefile and package scripts.
Added root Makefile targets for install, format, format-check, gitleaks, gitleaks-staged, precommit, husky-install, build-wasm, and build.
Added npm scripts for formatting, staged formatting, gitleaks scanning, Husky prepare, and precommit orchestration.
Added Husky install and pre-commit files plus Prettier configuration and ignore rules.
Installed Husky and Prettier with npm install, which also initialized Git hooks.
Adjusted the staged-format helper to use rustfmt directly instead of cargo fmt because the repo path dependency on zed-editor caused cargo fmt to hang.
Adjusted the staged-format helper to tolerate the sandbox-specific spawnSync git EPERM quirk when the command still exits successfully.
Verified doctor, format, format-check, make help, make gitleaks-staged, and npm run precommit.

commands.outcome: Succeeded. Installed husky and prettier, created package-lock.json, and set Git hooksPath to .husky/_.
Succeeded. Prettier formatting completed and rustfmt formatting completed without hanging.
Succeeded after the staged-format helper was updated.
Succeeded with no staged leaks found.
Ran successfully as a history scan but reported 7 existing historical findings already present in repository history.

decisions: Use Husky with a lightweight prepare script so hook installation is automatic after npm install but does not hard-fail before dependencies exist.
Use staged formatting plus staged gitleaks scanning in pre-commit to keep hooks fast and relevant to new changes.
Use rustfmt directly for Rust files instead of cargo fmt because cargo fmt was not appropriate for this repo layout.
Keep full-repo gitleaks available as a history scan even though it currently reports pre-existing findings.
issues: Full-repo gitleaks history scan reports 7 existing findings from repository history, including entries tied to commit 058ac8ae0ce6746c8d41298e2aba9bd53cc75b95 in crates/agent/src/tools/*.
The pre-commit hook is healthy because it scans staged changes, not the full historical backlog.
next_steps: Decide whether to keep make gitleaks as a history scan or switch it to a current-tree scan with an explicit gitleaks config.
If desired, add a .gitleaks baseline or ignore strategy for historical findings so the full-repo command can pass cleanly.
Consider extending doctor to warn when gitleaks is missing from PATH.
